newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Iceland central bank sees '97 CPI 2.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Iceland central bank sees '97 CPI 2.9 pct.

text.p: Iceland's central bank on Friday forecast consumer prices would rise 2.9 percent over the full calendar year 1997.
The Central Bank of Iceland also said in a statement that it forecast a rise of three to 3.5 percent in consumer prices in 1998 and 2.5 percent in 1999.
"The forecast was done in the wake of wage settlements between the principal private sector trade unions and employers associations," the bank said in a statement.
